description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Scan and remediate dependency CVEs before broader Azure migration work.
tasks.reason: Security hardening is required in every modernization plan to reduce risk before additional migration tasks are executed.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities using minimum patched versions. Document major-version upgrade risks and verify project build and tests after remediation.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Use the existing Java 11 and Gradle project environment.
